function: Learns each UE's uplink transmit power level, subchannel and serving-BS association (access control) in a satellite-backhauled network to minimize average packet delay (p. 5).
system: 4 BSs, 10 UEs, 2 subchannels (2 GHz); LEO satellite at 550 km, 30 GHz backhaul; no antenna arrays or RIS modelled (p. 10-11).
method: EC-MARL: QMIX value-decomposition MARL with GRU, attention-aggregated learned cooperation messages (emergent communication); centralized training, decentralized execution; DDQN-style reinforcement learning (p. 7-9).
data_channel: Offline simulator: UE-BS path loss with Rayleigh fading; BS-satellite backhaul 'specified by the 3GPP' (TR 38.821, 38.811) with Rician fading; random-waypoint UEs (p. 4, 10).
test_conditions: Trained offline in the simulator; 20 test runs under varied traffic load, power levels, backhaul bandwidth; 30-UE case shown as training curves; no unseen-condition test (p. 9, 12-14).
baselines: Learned: conventional Q-Mix, IQL (independent DDQN learners). Non-learned: maxSINR, each UE picks the highest-SINR BS at maximum power (p. 10-11).
metrics: Average packet delay, average sum throughput, and episode return (convergence) versus traffic load, power levels, backhaul bandwidth, and message dimension (p. 11-13).
complexity: Analytic time complexity of the execution phase (GRU Jl(T k^2) plus message, aggregation and Q networks) and mixing network for training; no runtime or parameter count (p. 10).
q1_support: p. 10: "we adopt the channel model specified by the 3GPP [48], [49]" for the BS-satellite backhaul; [48] and [49] are TR 38.821 and TR 38.811 (p. 15). The UE-BS access channel is custom path loss with Rayleigh fading (p. 4).
q2_support: p. 12: "under varying traffic loads, different numbers of power levels, and varying total BS-satellite backhaul channel bandwidths". No policy trained in one setting is said to be tested in another; the 30-UE cases (p. 14) are training curves.
q3_support: p. 10: "we compare it with conventional Q-Mix and independent Q-learning (IQL) algorithms" (learned); p. 11: "a reference policy called maxSINR" (non-learned). Compared on packet delay and throughput (p. 12).
q4_support: p. 10: "the overall time complexity for the execution phase is" an analytic expression in GRU, message, aggregation and Q-network sizes (Sec. V-E); the mixing network cost is given for training.
q5_support: p. 9: "we construct an offline discrete-time simulated environment for neural network training". The data come from the authors' own simulator; the paper gives no code or data link and uses no public dataset.
notes: Included, area 6, borderline. Learned actions are UE transmit power level, subchannel and BS association (p. 5): power and subchannel choice is physical-layer control learned jointly with association, so above_phy does not apply. The controlled links are terrestrial UE-BS uplinks and the satellite backhaul has fixed power and equal bandwidth shares (p. 4), so the NTN fit is for the reviewer to confirm. q1 rests only on the p. 10 statement that the backhaul follows 3GPP TR 38.811/38.821, while eq. (3) and (5) on p. 4 are free-space loss with Rayleigh and Rician fading: reviewer to confirm. q3: Q-Mix is the proposed method without emergent communication (ablation-like), so the learned baseline rests on IQL (DDQN) and Q-Mix as a published algorithm [35]. PDF title and DOI match on p. 1.
